spans.s:
√vij (vijáte; vivijé; ávikta [834c]; vijiṣyáti;
vigná). move with a quick darting
motion, ἀίσσειν; (like Eng. start) move
suddenly from fear. [cf. AS. wīc-an,
‘give way’; Eng. weak, ‘yielding, soft,
feeble.’]
+ ud, start up; be affrighted; udvigna,
terrified.

vijayá, m. victory; personified, Victory,
name of a rabbit. [√ji + vi.]

vijitendriya, a. having the organs of
sense subdued. [vijita + indriya.]

vijñéya, grdv. to be known or considered
as. [√jñā + vi, 963^3a.]
